reddit.title: Improved Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made some exciting updates to the audio in Provincia! Music transitions now feature a seamless crossfade, enhancing your gameplay experience. No more jarring cuts between day, night, and combat music. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
